name: Central Mowich Face

pitch_detail.notes: On the harder, right-hand variation only
4-6 pitches of steep snow to the Liberty Cap glacier on the harder variation; 40-50° on the original line

descent_text: From Liberty Cap or the main summit, descend via Emmons-Winthrop to Camp Schurman, or via Disappointment Cleaver to Camp Muir, depending on party preference and conditions.
approach: Mowich Lake has had no road access since the SR 165 Fairfax Bridge closed in April 2025, with no detour; reaching the lake now means a long walk in on the Wonderland Trail from another part of the park. From Mowich Lake, take the Wonderland Trail 4 miles to Spray Park. Climbers trail ascends lower Ptarmigan Ridge. At 8,300 ft, descend 1,000 ft to North Mowich Glacier.
overview: A northwest-facing ice/snow face route above Mowich Lake, with an easier original line (Grade III) and a harder, more direct variation (Grade IV) both topping out on the Liberty Cap glacier.
beta: Original variation: cuts left at 12,500 ft to an hourglass of snow/ice/rock, gaining a ledge that leads to a 40-50° snow ramp to the top. Harder variation: cuts right instead, through a couple of AI2-3 ice steps and a 4-6-pitch section of 50-60° snow to the same high point.
fa: Dee Molenaar, Gene Prater, Jim Wickwire, and Dick Pargeter
face: Northwest side, between North Mowich Headwall and Ptarmigan Ridge
